title: Seacrest Captain`s Choice Panama City Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewHot TubHot Tub- Screen Porch Living Area-Steps to Lagoon Pool! Private Beach- 4 Bikes! 'Captain's Choice'The Space Captain's Choice – Spacious Beach Retreat with Incredible Outdoor Living! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Amazing Outdoor Spaces – Screened-in porches, multiple balconies & cozy seating Two Master Suites – King-sized beds with private en-suite baths Spacious Open-Concept Living & Dining – Perfect for entertaining & relaxing Large Screened-In Porch on First Floor – Unwind after a fun day on 30A Second-Floor Balcony with Dining & Outdoor TV – The ultimate outdoor hangout spot 4 Adult Bikes Included – Explore Seacrest, Rosemary, Alys & Inlet Beach Short Walk or Bike Ride to Shops & Restaurants – Prime location near 30A’s best spots Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to Captain's ChoiceCaptain's Choice is a four-bedroom home built for peace and relaxation. With plenty of room inside and out, this home is perfect for your family and friends to kick back, relax and forget where you're from! After a long day at the beach, cozy up in the home's spacious living areas or stroll out onto one of the home's many porches & balconies to take in the Gulf breeze! The home features beautiful furnishings throughout and a cozy beach vibe so you can feel right at home. Within a short walk/bike ride, you will find many great shops, restaurants, bars and other activities not only in Seacrest Beach but also in the neighboring communities of Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Inlet Beach.You will enjoy the outdoor living spaces on both the first and second floor of the home. The back porch on the first floor is a perfect relaxation spot for a fun filled active day biking on 30A or fun in the sun on the beach.On the first floor you will find three bedrooms. One bedroom has a twin bed with a twin trundle and a set of twin bunks. The bunk room has a private bath! The second bedroom is one of the Master bedrooms. It has a king-sized bed and private bath. This floor also has a guest bedroom with two full sized beds. Also on this floor is a huge laundry room with ample counter space.The second floor is home to an awesome open, living, dining space. A second king master bedroom with private bath also available on this floor.The outdoor space for this home cannot be beat. On the first floor you will find a large screened in porch with plenty of seating. The balcony on the second floor has a dining table with 6 chairs and a couple of outdoor couches that surround a TV!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.****Please note there is construction ongoing behind the property. **SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):Master Bedroom: King sized bed, private bath with tub/shower comboMaster Bedroom: King sized bed, private bath with XL stand-up showerGuest Bedroom: Two full sized beds, private bath with shower/tub comboGuest Bedroom: Twin bed with trundle, twin over twin bunk, private bath with standing showerAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​Show less
